sample_definition: 1,119 byte-distinct, classified Opus-made yes/likely X-preview MP4s
color_vector_method: 21-bin distribution: 3 CIELAB L* bands x (Lab-neutral C*<18 or six 60-degree HSV hue sectors); crop 9 frames, resize 32x32; Hellinger-transformed K-means per category; equal file weight
cluster_selection_method: n<12: one mode; otherwise minimum mode size max(3,ceil(0.06n)); k=2, or k=3 for n>=30 if silhouette within 0.015 of k=2 and >=0.16; if no feasible split, one mode
palette_method: six Lab MiniBatchKMeans swatches per color mode, with actual all-pixel assignment shares
likes_note: Post-level descriptive values, deduplicated within each mode; ambiguous multi-file posts excluded from mode likes. Archived and exact Sep 27 likes are separate because observation times differ. Neither clustering nor palette fitting uses likes. No causal interpretation.

archive.file: working archive extract; per-video values included in data/color-study/per-video-color-vectors.csv
archive.observation_time: mixed/unknown per post; frozen from the working X archive on 2026-09-27

public_data_note: Source MP4s and nine-frame contact sheets are not redistributed; per-video color vectors, assignments, mode summaries and swatch counts are in data/color-study/.
